label: Web Console session management
type: the cluster security setting controlling how long an idle Couchbase Web Console session lasts, set as `uiSessionTimeout` in seconds via `/settings/security`, where the default 0 means no timeout is applied at all.
evidence: Use the `/settings/security` URI, with the `uiSessionTimeout` flag specifying the number of _seconds_ that a session is permitted to last.
Note that 0 seconds, which is the default, specifies that no timeout is applied.
note: An insecure-by-default setting stated plainly - console sessions never expire unless an administrator configures it - which is exactly the class of fact a security review needs and which no reference page in the corpus carries. Recurs at 3 because two overview pages route to the procedure, which is the ordinary shape of recurrence in an administration tree: one page does the work, several point at it.
